payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about previously reported results in terms of performance metrics and comparisons between models.

claims.text: Substantial improvements over previously reported results were achieved, with at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.
XLNet consistently outperformed BERT and RoBERTa on the tasks, which contrasts with results on other benchmark datasets.
Results for speculation detection and scope resolution using single-dataset training were reported as an average of 5 runs of the model.
For cue detection, results were reported using the Average method only, while scores for Scope Resolution were reported for both Average and First Token methods.
